pgAbout.storyP1: Guangzhou Frank brings over twenty years of expertise in hydraulic applications, specializing in high-performance hydraulic solutions for excavators. Our core products include hydraulic pumps, swing motors, travel devices, reducers, and spare parts — compatible with Volvo, Doosan, Hyundai, Sany, XCMG, Liugong, SDLG and etc. These components are recognized for their excellent power stability and durability, ensuring efficient operation in extreme working conditions.
pgAbout.storyP2: Guangzhou Frank was founded on a single principle: deliver components that match or exceed OEM specifications. Today, Frank Hydraulics supplies piston pumps, swing motors, travel motors, reduction gears, and a wide range of spare parts for excavators from 1 to 70 tons. We offer the same OEM-level quality and sourcing discipline directly to worldwide. Our commitment remains unchanged: deliver precision-engineered parts that keep your machines running.
pgAbout.missionDesc: To provide global construction equipment owners with reliable, cost-effective hydraulic solutions backed by rigorous quality control and responsive customer service.
pgAbout.visionDesc: To become the preferred sourcing platform for excavator hydraulic parts in emerging markets, recognized for integrity, speed, and technical expertise.

pgFamily.pistonHeroDesc: Full range of variable displacement axial piston pumps — K3V, K5V, K7V series. Designed for excavators from 5 to 50 tons.

pgFamily.pistonF2D: Available in various rotary group layouts, tandem type with PTO, and parallel type to match your specific application.
pgFamily.pistonF3D: Optimized for the most common hydraulic excavator systems with variable displacement pumps in open center control.
pgFamily.pistonF4D: Compatible with electronically controlled positive displacement control systems for efficient, smooth, precise operation.
pgFamily.swingHeroDesc: Compact, high-torque swing motors for smooth upper-structure rotation across 1–70 ton excavators.

pgFamily.swingF2D: Space-saving design fits standard swing frames without modification.
pgFamily.swingF3D: Flange and shaft configurations available to match major excavator brands.
pgFamily.swingF4D: Field-tested in demanding job sites with consistent performance over long service life.
pgFamily.travelHeroDesc: Integrated travel motor and reduction gear units built for extreme job-site conditions.
pgFamily.travelF1D: Motor and reducer in one sealed unit for simplified installation and fewer leak points.
pgFamily.travelF2D: Optimized gear meshing delivers strong tractive force with low energy loss.
pgFamily.travelF3D: Heavy-duty seals resist mud, water, and dust ingress during tough operation.
pgFamily.travelF4D: Matched to common excavator makes for direct, hassle-free replacement.
pgFamily.reductionHeroDesc: Precision helical gear sets for swing and travel reduction drives.

pgFamily.reductionF2D: Tight tolerances ensure correct alignment and quiet operation.
pgFamily.reductionF3D: Each unit is inspected and recorded for quality assurance.
pgFamily.reductionF4D: Built to original dimensions for straightforward installation.
